3. author surname + publication year (co-occurring inside a single bibliography entry block)

corpus_academic_note: 24 corpus entries are peer-reviewed and in principle database-indexable, yet none was returned by this search. Two (Axelsson 2000; Sommer & Paxson 2010) fall outside the 2018 date filter. Most of the rest are database-systems papers (PVLDB, CIDR, SIGMOD: Delta Lake, LHBench, FastLanes, F3, LogLite, Blitzcrank, DBSP, Ursa) whose titles and abstracts carry the storage/engine half of the query but not the security half, so the conjunctive query could not reach them. That asymmetry is itself a finding about the search strategy, and it is reported rather than repaired.
